answer: The finality of attestations only counts when the attestator is established, so a fresh cluster of aliases cannot push any transaction to finality until it has spent many epochs proving honesty. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain. Consider a grove as the anchor of the cost.
